reader.requirement: In format 2 (and format 3's REPLACING), ALL, LEADING or FIRST written once applies to every following 'operand BY replacement' pair, identifiers and figurative replacements included, until the next adjective or CHARACTERS; each carried FIRST pair is its own FIRST phrase (GR15d), and a pair with no adjective is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition (active from 2023): at 85 a BEFORE delimiter is searched from the leftmost position (beforeFromLeftmost=true), at 2023 from the AFTER-derived start
DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 the SR7/SR8/SR9 size rules ask identifier-3/5/6/7 static sizes at compile time; from 2002 only literals (identifier sizes become run-time EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE)

reader.edition-search: the adjective carry consults no edition; grep over the INSPECT binder, emitter and runtime found the two sites listed, neither of which switches the adjective
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf16_01 T1-T3 cover literal pairs; not exercised there: identifier pairs, figurative replacements, CHARACTERS between adjectives, two FIRST pairs with one literal, the refusals

probes.expected: FIRST "A" BY "1" "A" BY "2" replaces two A's (GR15d); CHARACTERS ends ALL; per-pair BEFORE; FIRST carried after LEADING; an identifier pair and ZERO; SPACE and QUOTE replacements
identifier and subscripted patterns inherit LEADING, ALL and FIRST

probes.printed: COBOL5506 unexpected '"A"' ... expected ALL, CHARACTERS, FIRST, LEADING or TRAILING
probes.expected: refused: a pair with no adjective
refused: a carried operand with no BY

probes.printed: COBOL2269 INSPECT REPLACING TRAILING ... prints only CHARACTERS, ALL, LEADING and FIRST
COBOL1757 'ALL "Q"' is a figurative constant that begins with the word ALL

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR14  the text is in GR14 (quoted: "are adjectives that apply to each succeeding BY phrase until the next adjective appears")
OK  §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR15d  the text is in GR15d (quoted: "This rule applies to each successive specification of the FIRST phrase regardless of the value of literal-1")

reader.notes: Each inspectReplacingPair inherits its item's kind in BindPhraseOperands; the runtime keeps a separate live flag per FIRST operand, so carried FIRST pairs each replace one occurrence.

refuter.evidence: q2.cob (q2-001, --std 85): ALL carried to figurative literal-1 pairs (SPACE BY "2", QUOTE BY ZERO) printed Q4=[121012]. LEADING SPACES BY ZEROS followed by FIRST "A" BY "b" "A" BY "c" printed Q5=[00bc  ], so the carried FIRST is its own FIRST phrase (GR15d). Identifier and function pairs gave F2=[babaXA]. Refusals (--compile-only, EXIT 65): rb `ALL "B" BY "1" CHARACTERS BY "*" "A" BY "2"` (no adjective carries past CHARACTERS) COBOL2269; rk two BEFORE phrases on a FIRST phrase (SR4) COBOL2269; rp CHARACTERS BY a 2-character literal (SR8) COBOL0846. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR14 ("apply to each succeeding BY phrase until the next adjective appears"); OK §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR15d.
